description: Replace exact batch-640 n=512 tile-major sidecar triple staging with cp.async.bulk or TMA transfers and mbarrier double buffering, letting one warp issue contiguous prior-factor tiles while MathDx consumes the alternate bank. Explore descriptor/layout choices and overlap sidecar conversion with preceding TRSM writeback, preserving the accepted n=2048/n=1024/n=256 paths, caller-stream binding, caches, repeated outputs, fresh inputs, policy checks, and full-grid correctness.

Replaced 128-thread 16-byte sidecar triple copies with three lane-0 2 KiB cp.async.bulk transfers, two shared mbarriers, and alternating-bank phase tracking. Build and 17-shape validation plus fresh-input guard passed, but active batch640 n512 specialization failed because ptxas rejected the legacy L2::128B modifier on cp.async.bulk; no complete benchmark metric was emitted.

Removed the unsupported legacy L2 hint and measured the lane-0 three-transfer cp.async.bulk/mbarrier double buffer. Build, policy, 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed; target batch640 n512 measured 2004.417 us versus parent 1606.331, and full-grid geomean measured 926.677 us versus 912.313.

Coalesced each adjacent panel-factor pair into one 4 KiB bulk transfer while lane 0 issued the separate 2 KiB current-panel tile and lane 1 issued the pair against one mbarrier. Full validation and all grid cells passed; target improved from 2004.417 to 1592.028 us and from parent 1606.331, while aggregate measured 913.534 us versus parent 912.313 amid slower untouched n2048.

Collapsed contiguous first-panel triples where j=k+1 into one 6 KiB bulk transfer, retaining the two-transfer schedule for separated triples. Validation and all grid cells passed; target measured 1647.696 us versus 1592.028 for unconditional 2+4 KiB transfers, and aggregate measured 920.335 us versus 913.534 with an unrelated noisy n2048 cell.

Reused one phase-tracked mbarrier across both alternate half-factor banks because only one bulk triple is pending at a time, retaining the warp-distributed 2+4 KiB transfers while shrinking shared barrier state. Full validation and all 15 cells passed; target measured 1590.718 us versus 1592.028 with two barriers and parent 1606.331; aggregate measured 912.191 us versus 913.534 and parent 912.313.

Fused paired FP32 output writeback and FP16 sidecar conversion in a linked float2/half2 helper, with four vector segments per thread and a closing barrier for changed shared-memory ownership. Full validation and grid passed; target measured 1993.146 us versus 1590.718 for scalar writeback, and aggregate measured 925.432 us versus 912.191.

Replaced lane-0 mbarrier polling plus CTA synchronization with all-thread acquire-polling while restoring scalar sidecar writeback. Build, policy, 17 validation cases, and fresh-input guard passed, but the full benchmark produced no output for 2270.720 s, far beyond the 1200 s ranked timeout, on the exact batch-640 n=512 specialization; the Modal job was terminated and no complete metric was emitted.

Used the successful Brev index-5 capture's 3.3-way shared-load and 3.1-way shared-store conflict evidence to pad all six FP16 MathDx tiles to aligned leading dimension 40, then distributed three 64-byte row-level cp.async.bulk transfers across one warp under the existing phase-tracked mbarrier. Build, policy, 17 tests, and fresh-input guard passed, but the exact batch-640 n=512 benchmark produced no output for 1444.620 s and was terminated after exceeding the 1200 s limit, indicating the multi-lane bulk issue/transaction protocol did not complete; no metric was emitted.

Repacked the n512 global factor sidecar itself at aligned leading dimension 40, letting the legal two-issuer cp.async.bulk path copy each 2.5 KiB tile and contiguous 5 KiB pair directly into equally padded MathDx operands under one mbarrier. Build, policy, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed; target batch640 n512 improved from 1590.718 to 1248.196 us and aggregate from 912.191 to 900.501 us, converting the Brev profile's shared-bank evidence into a 21.5% target reduction.

Removed the obsolete bulk-bank selector from the padded n512 copy helper, Numba ABI, prefetch chain, and waits, collapsing identical parity branches and one unused panel-origin value. Build, policy, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed; target measured 1281.431 us versus 1248.196 for the padded parent, while aggregate measured 903.113 versus 900.501 with a slower unrelated n256 cell.

Combined the padded global/shared LD40 half-factor bulk layout with compile-time LD36 FP32 Cholesky, TRSM, and GEMM accumulator tiles, including aligned asynchronous panel destinations and fully stride-aware scalar movement. Build, policy, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed; target batch640 n512 improved from 1248.196 to 1097.443 us and from 1590.718 at the single-mbarrier parent, while aggregate measured 898.307 us despite slower noisy untouched n256/n2048 cells.

Extended the Brev-guided padded LD40 sidecar layout to every remaining single and paired factor load using aligned 16-byte cp.async helpers, overlapping them with LD36 diagonal and accumulator movement while retaining bulk triple staging. Build, policy, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed; target batch640 n512 improved from 1097.443 to 1013.057 us and aggregate from 898.307 to 889.532 us.

Extended 4-byte cp.async staging from the proven paired accumulators to every FP32 diagonal, single, pair, and triple source tile while retaining padded layouts and asynchronous half-factor loads. Build, policy, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed, but target batch640 n512 regressed from 1013.057 to 1311.517 us and aggregate from 889.532 to 901.826 us, showing full-tile async source traffic outweighed overlap.

Replaced all 4-byte n512 FP32 cp.async source operations with two aligned float4 waves per tile using explicit base recovery and LD36 destinations. Local build, policy gates, all 17 official tests, and fresh-input guard passed, but the full active benchmark rejected exact batch640 n512 because output contained NaN or Inf; no complete metric was emitted and this vector-copy state will not be carried forward.

Compacted the padded n512 global factor sidecar from all 256 tile slots to the 136 upper-triangular tiles actually produced and consumed, preserving each LD40 tile's contiguous 2.5 KiB and adjacent-pair 5 KiB bulk-copy contract. Build, policy, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed; target batch640 n512 improved from 1013.057 to 993.681 us and aggregate from 889.532 to 884.544 us while sidecar storage fell 46.9%.

Changed only padded n512 half-tile cp.async loads from cache-all to cache-global so the saved profile's L1/TEX bottleneck would be bypassed while bulk and FP32 paths remained unchanged. Build, policy, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed; target measured 1018.212 us versus 993.681 for cache-all and aggregate measured 889.846 versus 884.544 amid slower untouched cells.

Acted on the new compact-candidate Brev profile's shared-memory occupancy limit by removing the second 7.5 KiB half-factor bank and alternating-bank control flow, serializing each compact padded triple bulk load through the same bank while restoring cache-all half loads. Build, policy, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed; target batch640 n512 measured 992.825 us versus 993.681 with double buffering, and aggregate measured 882.301 versus 884.544.

Resumed the stale slot at trial16 and closed it cleanly on best validated commit 9e9f80a3d9bd18d56538a397c8ca0b9f586e7f02: 882.301 us aggregate and 992.825 us batch640 n512, using one compact padded LD40 factor bank after e7f243f's double-bank path measured 884.544/993.681. Exact e7f243f hosted index5 NCU evidence showed 64 registers/thread, 29.20 KiB shared memory, 25.65% achieved occupancy, 58.05% no-eligible cycles, and 1.6-way/2.4-way shared load/store conflicts. A recovered row-complete 8-byte half-load remap passed wrapped build, all 17 tests, and the fresh-input guard, but was not benchmarked per manager wrap-up and was discarded uncommitted. Continue from 9e9f80a or exact-profiled 01e2d6e with a MathDx-compatible shared-store swizzle, corrected row-mapped FP32 staging, or stage-specific paired operators while preserving double-buffer overlap. No new hosted profile was launched.
